query: Please implement a random video chat website similar to Omegle with a better user interface and user experience. The website should have features such as random matching, video chat, text chat, and screen sharing. Users should be able to register and log in, fill out their profiles, set matching preferences, and start random video chats. The website should have real-time communication functionality, allowing users to send text messages, emojis, and files. Set page background to light steel blue; color all components with royal blue.
